title: Pipe-tier exact-equality invariant has no mutation-check; node premature-listing direction also untested
evidence:
{"streaming listed in era 1", replace1(ERAS_VALID, `"packet_types": ["email"]`, `"packet_types": ["email", "streaming"]`, 1), "listed before its era"},
		{"era-2 roster missing email", `{"eras": [` + ERAS_ROW + `, ` + ERAS_ROW_2_MISS_ROSTER + `]}`, "missing from the era-2 roster"},
		{"era-2 unlock missing small_biz", `{"eras": [` + ERAS_ROW + `, ` + ERAS_ROW_2_MISS_NODE + `]}`, "missing from the era-2 unlock table"},
detail: The eras_rows table mutation-checks invariant (a) for packet both directions and node missing only. The pipe-tier invariant loop (catalog.odin:1218-1228: `if cat.pipe_tiers[ti].era_introduced <= era && !in_table {`) is never exercised in a failing row; node premature-listing is also untested.
recommended_fix: Add failing rows: era-1 listing wide (tier premature), era-3 row dropping wide (tier missing), era-1 listing small_biz (node premature).

title: No unit binary roundtrip test for Cmd_Era_Advance (every prior command tag has one)
evidence:
append(&state.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 1, kind = Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = res, b = rt, tier = std}})
	append(&state.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 50, kind = Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = res, b = rt, tier = std}})

	bytes := log_write(&state, context.temp_allocator, state.era)
detail: test_action_log_binary_roundtrip and the demolish/placement/qos roundtrips exercise only pre-existing tags; no unit test log_write/log_read roundtrips a Cmd_Era_Advance. The tag-7 serialization is covered only end-to-end via the era_advance.dem golden replay gate.
recommended_fix: Append a Cmd_Era_Advance to test_action_log_binary_roundtrip and assert the read-back command matches to_era.

title: Advance firing on the terminal tick is untested (era_step runs before win_lose_eval; the barrier only gates later ticks)
detail: era_test.odin has no test where an advance is pending on the tick win_lose_eval latches terminal. Since era_step precedes win_lose_eval within a tick, the claimed skip only holds for post-terminal ticks; the same-tick ordering (era flip + terminal event together) is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a test with a pending advance on the win/lose tick asserting the emitted event order and final state.

title: era_advance_validate to_era=0 boundary and the last-write-wins double-latch are untested
evidence:
// Last-write-wins (a second request while one is pending replaces the target —
// deterministic; the MVP's single 2->3 advance never exercises it).
detail: The invalid-requests test covers backward (to_era==current) and out-of-table (era 5) but not to_era=0 (era.odin:52 `if c.to_era == 0 || int(c.to_era) > len(cat.eras) {`), and the documented last-write-wins re-latch of a second pending advance has no test at all.
recommended_fix: Add rows to test_era_advance_invalid_requests_latch_replay_error for to_era=0, and a two-request test asserting the second target replaces the first.

title: Harness `advance` verb fail-loud paths (parse + lower-time validation) have no negative coverage
detail: Three new error paths — demo.odin:450 `bad advance era` parse rejection, lower-time era-not-in-table, and the non-forward check above — are exercised only on the happy path by era_advance.dem. Harness has no test files, so a regression here fails silent until a bad demo is authored.
recommended_fix: Acceptable per harness convention; if cheap, add a ci-local negative-demo gate feeding a malformed advance line and asserting the fail-loud message.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 7/7 = 100% (advance fires + demand switch, E14 deferral via a REAL engine crisis, replay identity for fired AND deferred paths, invalid→replay_error, both invariants mutation-checked at least once, era_advance.dem golden + replay). P1 ≈ 8/10 = 80%: pipe-tier invariant mutation NONE, node premature direction NONE, Cmd_Era_Advance unit log roundtrip PARTIAL (golden-replay only). Overall ≥80% weighted. CONCERNS band (P1 80-89%).
recommended_fix: Add the three missing invariant (a) mutation rows (tier premature, tier missing, node premature) and a Cmd_Era_Advance binary roundtrip; that lifts P1 to ~100% and the gate to PASS.
